guitar.evidence: Steve Vai's Ibanez JEM signature series (with the iconic 'monkey grip' and 'Evo' guitar) is one of the most famous signature guitar lines in rock.

tone.target: liquid saturated Vai lead with wah and delay
tone.profile: liquid saturated Vai lead with wah and delay
tone.summary: A tight, saturated signal chain utilizing a Tube Screamer boost into a British high-gain amp model (UK 45/50) paired with a bright cab, incorporating Wah for expression and Digital Delay for space.

rig.name: Steve Vai - Building the Church - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up high-gain noise and hum.
Simulate the Tube Screamer boost for tight high-gain lead tone and sustain.
blocks.gap: The dedicated TS model is missing, but 'Boost' serves the function of tightening the signal before the amp stage.

alternatives.model: OD 9 (if a more aggressive boost is needed)

blocks.purpose: Provide the essential wah sweeps for lead playing.
Provide the core saturated high-gain tone required for Vai's lead work.
blocks.gap: While a dedicated high-gain model is preferred, 'Distortion' provides the necessary saturation and bite.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the bright, articulate British lead tone (Marshall/Boogie style).
Provide a bright and articulate platform for the high-gain lead tone.
Enhance the upper mids and high frequencies for maximum articulation and bite.
Add space and echo repeats to the lead lines.
Add subtle depth and sustain without muddying the aggressive lead tone.

alternatives.model: Room (if a more natural space is desired)

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism to better capture the bright, articulate sound required for Vai's lead work.

proposals.reason: Enhance articulation and brightness needed for complex leads.
